description: Weighted scoring for mission alignment grading. Map rule outcomes to points; sum for score. Blockers fail the run regardless of points.

blocker.description: Automatic fail if any blocker rule fails.

ruleScoring.normalization: After summing raw points from passed rules, scale linearly to 0-100 unless any blocker failed.

gradingProcedure: 1. Validate JSON artifacts against JSON Schemas (blockers).
2. Evaluate each applicable rule; record pass/fail/na with evidence strings.
3. If any blocker failed, set passed=false and gradeBand=fail unless waiver documented.
4. Sum points from passed rules using ruleOverrides and categoryCaps.
5. Normalize to 0-100; assign gradeBand from scale.gradeBands.

trainingMode.description: Weight traceability + verification_evidence highest; require narrative explanation for any failed major rule.
trainingMode.requireReflection: If score below passThreshold, agent must produce remediation plan listing exact files and next commands.
